queries.sparql: SELECT ?execution ?query ?queryGroup ?status ?outputDigest ?started ?ended WHERE { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:actual-execution> { ?execution a <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Activity> ; <http://purl.org/net/p-plan#correspondsToStep> ?query ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:queryGroup> ?queryGroup ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:status> ?status ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:outputDigest> ?outputDigest ; <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#startedAtTime> ?started . OPTIONAL { ?execution <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#endedAtTime> ?ended } } } ORDER BY ?started ?queryGroup ?query

SELECT ?trace ?candidate ?revision ?assertedRole ?selectedRole ?decision ?reason WHERE { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:qualification> { ?trace <urn:chronicle:predicate:candidate> ?candidate ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:candidateRevision> ?revision ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:assertedRole> ?assertedRole ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:decision> ?decision ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:reason> ?reason . OPTIONAL { ?trace <urn:chronicle:predicate:selectedRole> ?selectedRole } } } ORDER BY ?candidate ?assertedRole

SELECT ?trace ?role ?required ?condition ?conditionResult ?state ?reason WHERE { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:qualification> { ?trace <urn:chronicle:predicate:role> ?role ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:required> ?required ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:state> ?state ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:reason> ?reason . OPTIONAL { ?trace <urn:chronicle:predicate:condition> ?condition } OPTIONAL { ?trace <urn:chronicle:predicate:conditionResult> ?conditionResult } } } ORDER BY ?role

SELECT ?transition ?subject ?from ?to ?reason ?source WHERE { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:reasons> { ?transition <urn:chronicle:predicate:subject> ?subject ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:toState> ?to ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:reason> ?reason ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:source> ?source . OPTIONAL { ?transition <urn:chronicle:predicate:fromState> ?from } } } ORDER BY ?transition

SELECT ?axis ?receipt ?status ?artifact ?lineage ?dependency ?lineageDependency WHERE { { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:foundational-semantics> { ?foundation <urn:chronicle:predicate:microUseReceipt> ?receipt ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:evidenceArtifact> ?artifact . BIND("b03_micro_use" AS ?axis) OPTIONAL { ?receipt <urn:chronicle:predicate:relation> ?status } OPTIONAL { ?artifact <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom> ?dependency } } } UNION { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:foundational-semantics> { ?foundation <urn:chronicle:predicate:minimumDurationReceipt> ?receipt ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:evidenceArtifact> ?artifact . BIND("b04_minimum_duration" AS ?axis) OPTIONAL { ?receipt <urn:chronicle:predicate:relation> ?status } OPTIONAL { ?receipt <urn:chronicle:predicate:excludedLineageArtifact> ?lineage . OPTIONAL { ?lineage <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom> ?lineageDependency } } OPTIONAL { ?artifact <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom> ?dependency } } } UNION { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:foundational-semantics> { ?foundation <urn:chronicle:predicate:concurrencySubintervalFloorReceipt> ?receipt ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:evidenceArtifact> ?artifact . BIND("concurrency_floor" AS ?axis) OPTIONAL { ?receipt <urn:chronicle:predicate:effectiveApplied> ?status } OPTIONAL { ?artifact <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom> ?dependency } } } UNION { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:foundational-semantics> { ?foundation <urn:chronicle:predicate:zeroDurationCleanupReceipt> ?receipt . ?receipt <urn:chronicle:predicate:cleanupEvidenceArtifact> ?artifact . BIND("zero_duration_cleanup" AS ?axis) OPTIONAL { ?receipt <urn:chronicle:predicate:effectiveApplied> ?status } OPTIONAL { ?receipt <urn:chronicle:predicate:removedLineageArtifact> ?lineage . OPTIONAL { ?lineage <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom> ?lineageDependency } } OPTIONAL { ?artifact <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom> ?dependency } } } UNION { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:b05-screen-construction> { ?receipt a <urn:chronicle:class:b05-screen-construction-evidence> ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:evidenceArtifact> ?artifact . BIND("b05_screen_construction" AS ?axis) OPTIONAL { ?receipt <urn:chronicle:predicate:executable> ?status } OPTIONAL { ?artifact <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom> ?dependency } } } UNION { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:schoedel-reconstruction> { ?receipt a <urn:chronicle:class:schoedel-reconstruction-evidence> ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:evidenceArtifact> ?artifact . BIND("schoedel_reconstruction" AS ?axis) OPTIONAL { ?receipt <urn:chronicle:predicate:executable> ?status } OPTIONAL { ?artifact <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom> ?dependency } } } UNION { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:scientific-attestation> { ?receipt a <urn:chronicle:class:b05-schoedel-validation-receipt> ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:receiptArtifact> ?artifact ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:validationStatus> ?status . BIND("scientific_attestation" AS ?axis) OPTIONAL { ?artifact <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom> ?dependency } } } UNION { GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:eyes-partial-replay> { ?receipt <urn:chronicle:predicate:taggedFauEvidenceArtifact> ?artifact ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:replayStatus> ?status . BIND("eyes_tagged_fau" AS ?axis) OPTIONAL { ?artifact <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom> ?dependency } } } } ORDER BY ?axis ?receipt ?artifact ?lineage ?dependency ?lineageDependency

SELECT ?graph ?artifact ?kind ?assignment ?role WHERE { VALUES ?graph { <urn:chronicle:derived:foundational-semantics> <urn:chronicle:derived:b05-screen-construction> <urn:chronicle:derived:schoedel-reconstruction> <urn:chronicle:derived:scientific-attestation> <urn:chronicle:derived:eyes-partial-replay> } GRAPH ?graph { ?artifact <urn:chronicle:predicate:artifactKind> ?kind ; <urn:chronicle:predicate:scientificSourceAssignment> ?assignment . } GRAPH <urn:chronicle:derived:assignments> { ?assignment <urn:chronicle:predicate:role> ?role . } } ORDER BY ?graph ?artifact ?role ?assignment
